name: @cyclone-ui/inline-citation
description: InlineCitation, a source marker inside a sentence of an AI reply. InlineCitationCardTrigger is a small button labeled with the first source's hostname and a +N count (sources prop); it opens a hover card (InlineCitationCard, a Popover with open, defaultOpen and onOpenChange) on hover, keyboard focus or press, and Enter moves focus into it. InlineCitationCardBody holds InlineCitationSource (title, url, description), InlineCitationQuote and a carousel (InlineCitationCarousel with Header, Index, Prev, Next, Content and Item) that pages through several sources. InlineCitationText highlights the cited text while the citation is hovered.
